skill.name: karpathy-guidelines
skill.description: Behavioral guidelines to reduce common LLM coding mistakes. Use when writing, reviewing, or refactoring code to avoid overcomplication, make surgical changes, surface assumptions, and define verifiable success criteria.
skill.summary: Guide AI coding work toward clear assumptions, simple solutions, focused changes, and verifiable outcomes.
skill.author: multica-ai

content.user_title: Write Clearer Code with Focused Guidelines
content.value_statement: AI coding work can become overcomplicated, unfocused, or difficult to verify. This skill promotes explicit assumptions, minimal changes, and measurable success criteria.
actual_capabilities: Prompts the assistant to state assumptions before implementation.
Encourages the simplest solution that meets the stated request.
Limits edits to lines directly related to the requested change.
Turns vague tasks into goals with verifiable success criteria.
Guides code reviews toward scope, clarity, and test coverage.
limitations: Provides behavioral guidance but no executable tools or automation.
Does not replace project-specific standards, tests, or security review.
Biases toward caution, which can slow trivial tasks.
Requires enough project context to identify assumptions and relevant changes.

use_cases.title: Plan a Focused Implementation
use_cases.description: Define assumptions, scope, and verification before changing an existing feature.

use_cases.title: Review an AI-Generated Patch
use_cases.description: Check whether each change supports the request and avoids unnecessary refactoring.

use_cases.title: Clarify a Complex Coding Request
use_cases.description: Convert an ambiguous request into explicit decisions and measurable outcomes.

prompt_templates.title: Clarify a Coding Task
prompt_templates.prompt: Apply the Karpathy Guidelines to this task: {task}. State assumptions, identify ambiguity, and define a simple success criterion before proposing changes.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner planning a small coding task

prompt_templates.title: Create a Minimal Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan the implementation for {task} in {project_context}. Keep the scope narrow and pair every step with a concrete verification check.

prompt_templates.title: Review Patch Scope
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this patch description: {patch}. Identify unrelated changes, hidden assumptions, unnecessary abstractions, and missing verification. Recommend only changes required by {request}.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Verified Refactor
prompt_templates.prompt: For the refactor of {component}, define preserved behavior, pre-change checks, minimal edits, and post-change checks. Surface tradeoffs and reject speculative improvements.

output_examples.input: Add email validation to the existing registration flow.
output: Assumption: validation should follow the existing form error pattern.
Scope: update the email validation path and its focused tests only.
Success: valid addresses pass, invalid addresses show the expected error, and existing tests remain green.
Clarification needed: specify the behavior or maintenance problem the refactor must address.
Preserve current notification behavior and capture it with tests before editing.
Avoid new abstractions unless they remove duplication required by the stated goal.
First reproduce duplicate creation with a focused failing test.
Trace the smallest execution path that can create the second invoice.
The fix is complete when the reproduction passes and related invoice tests remain green.

best_practices: Provide the request, relevant project context, and existing constraints.
Ask for assumptions and verification criteria before implementation begins.
Compare the final changes against the original request line by line.
anti_patterns: Do not use the guidelines to avoid reasonable progress on well-defined tasks.
Do not request broad cleanup while claiming the change is narrowly scoped.
Do not treat guideline compliance as a substitute for tests or expert review.

faq.question: What does this skill change?
faq.answer: It changes the assistant's coding approach by emphasizing assumptions, simplicity, focused edits, and verification.

faq.question: Does the skill edit code automatically?
faq.answer: No. It provides behavioral guidance that an AI coding assistant applies while completing your request.

faq.question: Can I use it for code review?
faq.answer: Yes. It helps identify unrelated edits, unnecessary abstractions, hidden assumptions, and weak success criteria.

faq.question: Is it suitable for large projects?
faq.answer: Yes, when you provide enough context and divide the work into focused, verifiable steps.

faq.question: Will it prevent every coding mistake?
faq.answer: No. You still need project tests, security checks, domain expertise, and human review.

faq.question: Why can the approach feel slower?
faq.answer: It asks for clarity and verification before implementation. For trivial tasks, apply the guidance with reasonable judgment.
